original.transcript: Dave's card charged him six hundred ninety five dollars again. Chad points to a twenty dollar credit after an eighty dollar purchase. But the math is simple. Eighty minus twenty is sixty. Points monk counts only benefits Dave would have bought anyway. Then he compares that real value with the annual fee. If the value is higher, the card may make sense. If the fee is higher, rethink it. Ignore the flex and keep the math.
